project_name: Choose a project name. Should be a single word. Must be written in snake_case.
short_summary: Write a short tagline for your project.
long_summary: Explain your project in a bit more detail, 50-100 words would be ideal. Line-breaks are not needed as the text will be auto-wrapped.

__prompts__.python_version_min: Lowest supported python version, e.g. 3.11. Sets the floor of `requires-python` and the first entry of the CI test matrix.
__prompts__.python_version_max: Highest supported python version, e.g. 3.14. Used for `.python-version`, the docker base image and every `setup-python` step.
